predictedBugs: Counting every directory under agents would reproduce the aexos info inflation by including agent memory directories.
Treating every missing node_modules directory as valid would hide a real failure when package.json declares dependencies.
Making Claude checks unconditional would keep fresh init red, while making all present Claude artifacts optional could hide malformed installed integrations.
edgeCases: A greenfield project without package.json or node_modules must pass the project dependency portion of doctor.
A project with declared dependencies and no node_modules must still fail with an actionable npm install fix.
Missing optional Claude directories must pass, but present empty or incomplete Claude surfaces must retain their integrity warning or failure.
